findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_panel, ask_panel, export_panel, list_panels, get_panel_status, list_groups, create_group_from_brief, ask_group · Private data: create_panel, export_panel, create_group_from_brief · Public sink: export_panel, create_group_from_brief · Destructive: create_panel, ask_panel, export_panel, list_panels, get_panel_status, list_groups, create_group_from_brief, ask_group, plan_panel_study, run_panel_study, list_research_methods.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_panel, ask_panel, export_panel, list_panels, get_panel_status, list_groups, create_group_from_brief, ask_group · Private data: create_panel, export_panel, create_group_from_brief · Public sink: export_panel, create_group_from_brief · Destructive: create_panel, ask_panel, export_panel, list_panels, get_panel_status, list_groups, create_group_from_brief, ask_group, plan_panel_study, run_panel_study, list_research_methods

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
